sentences.text: Oil beetle is a general group name for beetles in the family A rare species of beetle has been found in Pembrokeshire after not being seen in Wales for 60 years.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: The Short-Necked Oil Beetle is named after the adult beetles' stubby shape and its ability to secrete an oily yellow-orange substance from its knee joints when alarmed.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: They were not reported in the UK for almost 60 years after 1948 as habitat loss brought the species to the brink of extinction.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Anne Hobbs, from the Bumblebee Conservation Trust, said it was "very exciting" that the evidence suggested the species was breeding in Wales again.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Experts praised the discovery as a positive sign for the species future The Short-Necked Oil Beetle is classed as nationally rare within Great Britain and listed as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List , external .
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: It is dependent on solitary bees for its lifecycle and needs a particular habitat to survive, with thick vegetation for shelter and dense flower coverage both essential.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: The larvae of Short-Necked Oil Beetles lurk among flowers, waiting for a passing bee to carry them back to its nest, where they feed on the pollen the bee has collected.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Last year, the survey at Castlemartin found only dead adults of this particular beetle, raising concerns about the future of this species and its continued presence on the site.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: But this year, after three years of searching, experts discovered larvae of the beetle on a small area of the site, suggesting that surveyors had managed to find some of the hatchlings from a larger batch of immature beetles.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: The number and distribution of the beetle larvae seen also supported this, according to Natural Resources Wales (NRW).
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: They can typically be found from March to June in flower-rich coastal grassland and sand dune habitat, and are most active on warm, sunny days.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Adults can grow up to 24mm (0.9in) in length and the life span of an adult is approximately one year.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: NRW said these conditions mean there are only a handful of suitable sites in the UK.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: They were rediscovered in Devon in 2006 and on the Isle of Coll, in Scotland, in 2009.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Since then, populations have been found on Tiree, Islay, Barra and Uist.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Castlemartin Range, in Pembrokeshire, is currently the only place in Wales where the species can be found and it is being consistently surveyed by conservationists.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: The project is part of Wales's "flagship species recovery programme", said NRW, which works to conserve the Short-Necked Oil Beetle Sand other species that share similar habitats.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: Hobbs described the Short-Necked Oil Beetle as an "amazing creature" and said their work needed to consider the "needs of several species to be effective".
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: She thanked their partners and volunteers for their continued support, despite having two years without a larval sighting.
sentences.article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years

sentences.text: A number of birds are injured after the incident Recovery efforts are continuing after an oil spill caused by the vandalism of a nearby home heating oil tank resulted in the death of 13 birds from Broughshane Waterfowl Park.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: More than 20 birds were transported to the USPCA's headquarters last week for urgent specialist care, but the death toll has continued to rise.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: The popular attraction in County Antrim has been forced to close while efforts continue to remove oil from the pond.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: Police have appealed for anyone with information to come forward.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: More than 20 animals were treated by a vet and transported to the USCPA in Newry Broughshane Environment Wildfowl and Wildlife Trust's chairman, Gary Hayward, said they incident had been a "nightmare".
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "We are devastated," he told BBC News NI.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "One of our volunteers appeared on the Thursday morning to feed [the birds], and walked down through the park and smelt this kerosene smell and saw the black swans completely oiled." The park is home to 120 "collection birds", as well as wild birds, he explained.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "So far we have lost 13 birds, some of which are really close to us." Hayward praised the efforts of the USPCA and Northern Ireland Environment Agency (NIEA), who have been instrumental in treating the sick birds and clearing up the spillage.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: The pond has become well known for its variety of waterfowl and has been in existence for 13 years The Northern Ireland Environment Agency (NIEA) was first alerted to the incident on Thursday 22 October and have been involved in trying to remove the oil waste.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "The incident was quickly confirmed as having had a significant impact on the ponds and NIEA inspectors deployed oil absorbent booms and other countermeasures as mitigation," a spokesperson said.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: The agency said the substance involved had been identified as home heating oil, or kerosene, and that the source had been traced to a nearby tank.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: The waterway is noted to be much improved but further works will be carried out as long as is deemed necessary.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: Gary Hayward believes it will be weeks before the park can return to normal Hayward hopes that the incident will be an deterrent to those engaged in vandalism.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "People need to be fully aware of what impact it can have if somebody vandalises a heating containers and tanks." Siobhan Hawthorn, wildlife supervisor at the USPCA, has been a key part of the rescue operation.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "It's massively frustrating when these kind of incidents occur, especially when it's caused by carelessness and us humans and these poor birds have suffered because of it," she said.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "There's no reason for them to have died needlessly for that reason." Siobhan Hawthorn says the team are "doing everything the can" to care for the sick birds Siobhan and the team have been working tirelessly to help revive the birds which include geese, ducks and swans.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "It's been a case of getting them all bathed and treated as soon as we could because of the level of contamination they suffered," she said.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "We've given them all doses of charcoal to help combat some of the toxins that they would have ingested.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "Unfortunately not all of them got to us as quickly as we would have liked and they have ingested too much," she added.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: This video can not be played A number of birds are injured after the spill from the oil tank earlier this week Some of the birds have now recieved a second bath to help take off the oil Siobhan and the team said the incident has also placed their staff under considerable pressure "emotionally and mentally".
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: The centre is unsure just how long they will have to care for the remaining birds.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: "We would like to think that they're over the worst of it, but you just don't know exactly how much they have potentially ingested," she explained.
sentences.article_title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'

sentences.text: US Assistant Attorney General Colin M McDonald vowed to pursue all those involved In May 2024, Francis Mogambi arrived in the United States after winning the Diversity Visa lottery, a programme that gives people from around the world a chance to become permanent residents.

sentences.text: Prosecutors allege that, between November 2025 and May 2026, he worked with associates in Kenya to steal the identities of US citizens and use them to fraudulently enroll fictitious students in American colleges.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: Once the fake students were enrolled, Mogambi allegedly diverted their financial aid payments to himself, keeping 30% and sending the remainder to his associates in Kenya.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: The intended loss in his case was $20,000 (£15,000), according to prosecutors.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: Mogambi was arrested shortly after the indictment was returned and is being held in custody pending trial.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: He has not yet commented on the allegations against him.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: His case forms part of a wider US investigation, dubbed Operation Ghostbusters, into the alleged use of stolen identities to enrol fictitious students at colleges and claim federal financial aid that resulted in a loss of $130m in taxpayers funds.

sentences.text: US authorities say the investigation has so far resulted in five indictments that involved Kenyan nationals, while a further 40 investigations remain open.
sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.article_title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam

sentences.text: The Gruffalo has been a staple of children's bookshelves since 1999 The illustrator behind the popular children's book The Gruffalo has told BBC London he is "seriously considering" launching legal action against artificial intelligence (AI) firms he says breach copyright in reproducing his work.

sentences.text: Lula's supporters mobilised en masse despite polls pointing to a defeat for the incumbent A WhatsApp channel created to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign is being credited by allies with helping deliver one of the most unlikely comebacks in recent Brazilian politics.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Brazil's left-wing president had been trailing right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro, but managed to turn the race around in just three weeks.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: At a moment when many doubted Lula could reverse the result, a WhatsApp channel called Lula's Army emerged, and rapidly grew to 10.8 million followers.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Led by Congressman André Janones, the operation encouraged supporters to share videos, promote hashtags and recruit new voters.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Its dramatic growth between the two rounds was particularly notable because it appeared to reverse a long-standing imbalance in Brazilian politics.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: For years, conservatives aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro had been widely seen as dominating online political mobilisation, especially on platforms such as WhatsApp and Telegram.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula called André Janones "our General" after his major contribution paid off The emergence of Lula's Army convinced many supporters that Brazil's left had finally found a way to compete in a digital arena.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: The shift was particularly significant because social media has played a central role in Brazilian politics since Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 election victory, when WhatsApp networks became a defining feature of political campaigning.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula's Army messages often included ready-made templates for followers to share with friends and family.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Each one assigned supporters a specific task aimed at boosting Lula's visibility on social media.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Janones frequently instructed his "troops" to "blow up" the latest campaign video or help a new hashtag "take off".
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "Guys, urgent!", "Don't go to sleep yet", "No food before the mission!", and "I have one more task before you're dismissed", were some of the instructions.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: On the eve of the election, the congressman also hosted a 24-hour live event - dubbed the "turnaround livestream" - even as polls continued to suggest a victory for Bolsonaro.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: The tactic worked, despite worries by some members of the Workers' Party that Janones's often-confrontational style on social media could undermine the more moderate image they hoped to project for Lula.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: In his victory speech, Lula referred to Janones as "our General" and thanked him for "raising the morale of our troops every day".
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Measuring the electoral impact of online mobilisation, however, is notoriously difficult.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: While Lula's allies credit Lula's Army with helping fuel the comeback, political scientists caution that it is impossible to determine how many votes, if any, were directly influenced by the WhatsApp operation.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Political scientist Denilde Holzhacker argues that a shift in Lula's campaign strategy was key to his comeback.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Rather than relying solely on online engagement, she says the Workers' Party candidate succeeded in connecting digital campaigning with grassroots mobilisation on the ground.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: According to Holzhacker, the campaign intensified local efforts and adapted its messaging - linking a Bolsonaro victory with concerns about potential changes to social programmes and the loss of rights.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "It was to Lula's credit that he recognised his own weakness and completely changed his style," she says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "And Janones managed to do something that had seemed unthinkable for Brazil's left - dominate social media." By contrast, Holzhacker argues that Flávio Bolsonaro entered the run-off overly confident of victory and failed to communicate his message to his supporters as effectively.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Sociologist and political scientist Mayra Goulart, a professor at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, also cautions against attributing Lula's comeback solely to social media.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "It was a combination of social media and street-level mobilisation," she says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "The physical world enabled a form of mobilisation capable of reducing abstention and persuading undecided voters." In her view, Lula's supporters succeeded in turning online enthusiasm into real-world political engagement.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "Those committed to Lula's victory worked to bring people together and persuade them to vote," Goulart says.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: She argues that the effort not only helped increase turnout but could also prove valuable for Lula's next administration.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "I believe this collective effort was an important learning experience and will prove valuable for a government that still faces many battles ahead.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: It not only helped reduce abstention, but also converted a significant number of undecided voters." Lula himself suggested that the mobilisation behind his comeback could shape the way he governs in the years ahead.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: In his victory speech, he said the election had taught him many lessons and pledged to change the way Brazil is governed.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "We are going to give people a greater say in decision-making, and digital communication will play a much bigger role in my government."
